lines.text: Did you know? Cide is Latin for cut or kill.
Decide: off plus cut or kill.
Decision: off plus cut or kill.
Quick quiz! Which means off plus cut or kill?
Decision! Off plus cut or kill.

words.ex: We decided to stay at home because of the rain.
Moving abroad was the biggest decision of my life.

publish.title: Cide root: decide and decision
publish.value: Cide comes from Latin "caedere" (to cut, to kill). Words: decide and decision. decide = de + cide; decision = de + cis.
